source.text: No other prior malignancy is allowed except for the following: adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ cervical cancer, adequately treated Stage I or II cancer from which the patient is currently in complete remission, or any other cancer from which the patient has been disease free for three years.
Women who are or are planning to become pregnant or breastfeed

Patients with solid tumors failing standard therapies or patients refusing standard treatments (exception: Part B NSCLC combination (EGFR TKI + AOH1996) cohort: patients with stable disease or better on EGFR TKI for at least 2 months)

mappings.appliesTo: Part B NSCLC combination (EGFR TKI + AOH1996) cohort
